items.title: An open impl generic leaks into a user expression's type: `Ok(5).map_err(\|code: str\| code)` analyzes to `Result<T(impl generic), str>` - the call's result keeps the receiver's `T` open instead of binding it from the payload (`i32`)
items.discussion: lane tooling-56 (Order 56): E342's hover fix fills the hole from the payload's recorded type or a literal's own type at the hover label, which WORKS AROUND this; the analysis itself still answers the open parameter, and a nested variant-call payload (`Ok(Some(2))`) still hovers bare (pinned as E342's residual)
items.body: The substitution for a variant receiver's method (`Result<T, E>::map_err` on an `Ok(5)` receiver) does not bind `T` from the constructor's payload when the method's own signature does not mention `T` in a position the call constrains. Rec: bind the receiver's enum parameters from the receiver EXPRESSION's recorded type before the method's substitution is built (the receiver type is `Result<i32, _>` already), so the result type closes; then E342's hover workaround and its nested residual fall away. Pin: the inference test answers `Result<i32, str>` for the repro and `Result<Option<i32>, str>` for `Ok(Some(2)).map_err(..)`. Sizing S-M.

items.title: Under plain `cargo test`, `edit_replay_differential`'s twelve N188 shards serialize on SWITCH_LOCK - 3264 s on the loaded box, where nextest runs them in ~100 s
items.discussion: lane tooling-56 (Order 56): N188 split the corpus-as-modules leg into 12 shard tests so nextest's process-per-test spreads them; `cargo test` runs them as threads of one process, and each takes SWITCH_LOCK (the global analyzer-world switch) for its whole run, so they queue
items.body: CI and the lane briefs run nextest, so nothing is red; a developer running `cargo test -p vilan-core --test edit_replay_differential` by hand waits most of an hour under load. Options: (a) document nextest as the only sanctioned runner for that binary (a `#[cfg]`-free note at the top plus the README's test section); (b) a `--test-threads=1`-aware guard that runs the shards in one thread when under `cargo test` (`RUST_TEST_THREADS` or nextest's `NEXTEST` env var) so at least the lock is not contended; (c) narrow SWITCH_LOCK's hold to the per-program analysis rather than the shard. Rec: (a) now, (c) when the lock is next touched. Sizing S.
